name: anythingmcp
description: Connect your business apps to Cursor through one hosted MCP server. AnythingMCP turns ERP, accounting, e-commerce, CRM and database APIs (Odoo, SAP, weclapp, Lexware Office, Shopify, Etsy, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and hundreds more) into tools the agent can call, with OAuth sign-in and per-workspace access control.
